main_text.p: אֵת m. Ligo: אִתּוֹ Ligonem suum: plur. אִתִּים, אִתִּים Ligones.

אָתָה Venit, Advenit, Accessit, Invasit. Chald. אתה Venit, אתו venerunt: לְמֵתָא Ad veniendum: וְאָתוּ Et venite: Ex Hiphil, הֵיתִיו Venire fecerunt, Adduxe-runt: לְהֵיתָיָה Ad adducendum. Hophal, הֵיתִיוּ Adducti sunt, &c. in Daniele & Esra.
אוֹת Signum, quod Eventurum aliquid portendit. Chald. אָר, quod ante positum. אתיות Eventura.
אֵיתוּת m. Ingressus. Ezech. 43.19 [?] אֲתָן f. Asina: plur. אתנות.
אַתְרָא Chal. Locus: אַתְרָה Locus ejus.
main_text.head: ב
main_text.p: בְּאֵר In Pihel Declaravit; Clarè exposuit.
בְּאֵר m. Puteus, Fons aquæ claræ & limpidæ: plur. בְּאֵרוֹת.
בָּאַשׁ Putruit, Fatuit. Niphal. נִבְאַשׁ Fa-tidus factus vel redditus fuit. Hiphil

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points are hard to read at this scan quality, so the pointing of several Hebrew words is uncertain and may not match the print. The last line is cut off at the foot of this part, so its reference is doubtful. The running head is Hebrew and was copied as seen.
